packages.authority: Initial startup claim, ordered initialization, launch reporting, launch-only presentation, and destination handoff
packages.persistence: Session-only launch report; configuration is project-owned
packages.boundary: First Light coordinates startup but never owns peer services
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Observatory – Diagnostics and Runtime Inspection
packages.authority: Validation vocabulary, runtime inspection, bounded diagnostics, provider aggregation, and support snapshots
packages.persistence: Session/support diagnostics only; no gameplay save
packages.boundary: Observes peers and never becomes their repair or behavior authority
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Global preferences, drafts, previews, apply/rollback transactions, validation, migration, and preference storage
packages.persistence: Own JSON document for global preferences; unknown sections/fields preserved
packages.boundary: Global preferences only, never save-slot gameplay progress
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Validated scene routes, transition admission, loading phases, activation, recovery, and travel results
packages.persistence: Session-only route/transition state; route definitions are project assets
packages.boundary: Owns Unity scene travel, not semantic world topology or gameplay outcomes
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Primary runtime mode, temporary override scopes, pause/time/cursor policy, and effective state history
packages.persistence: Session-only by default
packages.boundary: Coordinates policy; does not own UI screens, input maps, audio sources, or scene loads
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Music, SFX, ambience, mixer routing, voices, transport, handles, and audio runtime diagnostics
packages.persistence: Session-only playback state; global audio preferences live in Accord
packages.boundary: Owns playback, not event meaning or preference persistence
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Input contexts, locks, device/control-scheme state, rebinding, binding overrides, and glyph data
packages.persistence: Overrides/preferences persist through Accord or project provider; live contexts are session-only
packages.boundary: Owns input infrastructure, not movement or gameplay meaning
packages.platformDependency: Unity Input System

packages.authority: Screen, HUD, modal, notification, prompt, focus, navigation, and transition presentation infrastructure
packages.persistence: Presentation state is session-only unless another authority persists domain data
packages.boundary: Presents peer truth and never becomes the game-rule authority
packages.platformDependency: uGUI and TextMeshPro presentation path

packages.authority: Save files, slots, generations, manifests, participant routing, migration, backup, and recovery
packages.persistence: Owns save transport; package participants own their versioned payload meaning
packages.boundary: Does not invent gameplay schemas or global preferences
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Visible project composition, package selection, dry-run planning, setup-facade orchestration, receipts, repair, and removal guidance
packages.persistence: Editor transaction journal and project-owned generation receipts; no runtime save
packages.boundary: Never becomes a runtime manager or duplicates peer setup logic
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Feedback recipes, timeline instances, channel arbitration, scaling, cancellation, and provider requests
packages.persistence: Session-only instances/handles; preferences external
packages.boundary: Coordinates feedback but does not move cameras, play audio, or own time/input/UI
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Pool definitions, prewarm, reuse leases, bounded growth, retention, return safety, scopes, and diagnostics
packages.persistence: Session-only pool state
packages.boundary: Owns reuse, not spawn intent, gameplay rules, or network authority
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Ascent – Progression, Unlocks, Passwords, and Checkpoints
packages.authority: Unlocks, progression access, progression-node completion, passwords, checkpoints, and local records
packages.persistence: Versioned progression state through Chronicle, standalone provider, or project, exactly one active source
packages.boundary: Does not own objective-run completion, scene travel, save transport, or RPG stats
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Foundry – Build Preparation, Validation, and Release Output
packages.authority: Build recipes, preflight, versioning/stamping, output safety, build execution, receipts, checksums, and release preparation
packages.persistence: Project assets and build receipts/manifests; never gameplay save data
packages.boundary: Wraps Unity Build Profiles without replacing them or deploying silently
packages.platformDependency: Unity Editor Build Profiles / Build Pipeline

packages.formalPublicTitle: Many Tongues – Localization, Locale, and Regional Content
packages.authority: Locale selection, localized-reference facade, fallback/missing policy, formatting, script/font metadata, and invalidation
packages.persistence: Locale preference belongs to Accord; tables/assets are project content
packages.boundary: Does not own translation authorship, UI layout, dialogue flow, or audio playback
packages.platformDependency: Unity Localization package

packages.authority: Foreground conversation sessions, graph traversal, choices, conditions, typed commands, variables, and history
packages.persistence: Optional safe-point session snapshot through Chronicle; committed commands are not replayed
packages.boundary: Owns conversation flow, not localization, UI, audio, objectives, camera, or save transport
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Path – Objectives, Quests, and Tasks
packages.authority: Objective definitions, runs, steps, progress graphs, tracking, completion, and reward-delivery ledgers
packages.persistence: Objective state and reward ledger through Chronicle or project persistence
packages.boundary: Owns objective truth; reward executors own granted resources
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Vault – Inventory and Item Containers
packages.authority: Item definitions, stacks, unique instances, containers, equipment occupancy, and atomic inventory transactions
packages.persistence: Versioned inventory state through Chronicle or project persistence
packages.boundary: Does not own crafting, item effects, vendors, combat rules, or save transport
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Interaction offers, detection candidates, focus, prompts, reservations, sessions, cancellation, and commit policy
packages.persistence: Session-only focus/reservations; outcome owner persists durable consequences
packages.boundary: Routes interaction requests but does not own their gameplay result
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Camera channels, targets, groups, modes, blends, lens intent, bounds, zones, impulses, and backend execution
packages.persistence: Session-only camera state
packages.boundary: Owns the winning view intent, not characters, controllers, scene travel, or rendering policy
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Fellowship – Character Identity and Roster
packages.authority: Character definitions/IDs, rosters, availability, selection, spawning, runtime actors, control ownership, and switching
packages.persistence: Roster/availability/selection snapshot through Chronicle or project persistence
packages.boundary: Does not own movement, input devices, combat, inventory contents, or network provider authority
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.authority: Normalized family intent, actor-local controller hosts, motors, locomotion state, capabilities, and semantic movement events
packages.persistence: Session-only locomotion, intents, contacts, and leases
packages.boundary: No global controller root; does not own roster, input devices, camera, combat, or saves
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Crucible – Recipe Transformation and Production
packages.authority: Recipes, previews, requirements, stations, exact combines, atomic transformation requests, idempotency, and recipe knowledge
packages.persistence: Recipe knowledge may persist; resources remain with provider such as Vault
packages.boundary: Owns transformation rules, not inventory storage, UI, skills, item art, or multiplayer authority
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Convergence – Multiplayer Sessions and Authority
packages.authority: Session, participant, readiness, authority, reconnect, travel/spawn contracts, and provider capability facade
packages.persistence: Live network state is session-only; authoritative shared saves use Chronicle
packages.boundary: Does not replace networking SDKs or absorb gameplay-domain authority
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: Instinct – AI Perception, Decisions, and Behavior
packages.authority: Stimuli, observations, perception memory, scoring, scheduler budgets, blackboards, behavior seams, and navigation contracts
packages.topology: Actor-local hosts plus explicit world/scene registries
packages.persistence: Live AI state is session-only; optional approved snapshots at safe points
packages.boundary: Provides thinking infrastructure, not universal enemy design or a mandatory navigation backend
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: Clash – Combat Messages, Targets, and Resolution
packages.authority: Combat requests, targetability, relations, deterministic modifiers, receiver transactions, outcomes, and combat events
packages.persistence: Combat operations are session-only; target resource owners persist their own state
packages.boundary: Resolves combat operations but does not own every target resource or ability lifecycle
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: Arcana – Ability Activation and Effect Orchestration
packages.authority: Ability grants/loadouts, activation, costs, charges, cooldowns, casts, channels, interruption, targeting, and effect orchestration
packages.persistence: Grants/loadouts and optional charges/cooldowns may persist; active casts/effects never do
packages.boundary: Owns ability lifecycle, while Clash owns instantaneous combat resolution
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated

packages.formalPublicTitle: The Atlas – World Identity, Topology, and Travel Metadata
packages.authority: World/zone/location identity, topology, travel plans, scene bindings, entry/spawn markers, discovery, visitation, and world-state routing
packages.persistence: Optional context/discovery/provider records through Chronicle; runtime markers/plans are session-only
packages.boundary: Owns semantic world truth, not scene loading, actor movement, or procedural content
packages.platformDependency: Unity core/modules only; optional providers isolated
